incidents.name: Value DeFi vSafe WBNB vault cross-contract reentrancy
incidents.lossOther: ~$11M reported across the affected Value DeFi pools and the vSafe multi-strategy WBNB vault
incidents.notes: The vSafe WBNB vault's deposit/share calculation read its Alpaca ibBNB position mid-flight, so reentering deposit() from inside Alpaca Vault.work() minted the attacker vault shares against balances that had not yet been settled.

sources.ref: onchain review: vault 0xD4BBF439d3EAb5155Ca7c0537E583088fB4CFCe8 created 2021-03-05 by the Value DeFi deployer 0x9696969e67b37403196a3519edc176276714a724, unrelated to attack sender 0xcb36b1ee0af68dce5578a487ff2da81282512233; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events between creation and the incident block 7223030, so age measured from deployment. No high-confidence per-contract USD figure exists, so lossUsd is null; the incident is reported at ~$11M, far above the $1,000 floor.
